items.title: Piramal Finance Scales Its Internal Agentic AI Assistant With MongoDB
items.summary: Piramal Finance Limited is a retail-led upper-layer NBFC with a pan-India presence. It offers a diverse portfolio of retail lending products spanning affordable housing loans, loan against property, microfinance, personal loans, insurance solutions, and more, as well as wholesale lending, which provides asset-backed, data-driven financing solutions across real estate and select non-real estate sectors.
